castle.observation: combat calls combatmap before combatsetup, so battlefield construction and its random terrain decoration consume gameplay RNG before direction, separation, and actor placement. A land source cell expands through its active landlook's 3 by 3 build; dungeon cells use fixed 232, 233, 234, and 252 builds. Character missile use blocks at point blank, tests Euclidean range and line of sight, spends two half-attacks and twelve movement, and resolves the item-backed class-nine projectile through projectile shield and missile dodge rather than generic magic resistance.
